text:
leah_sales: Quick sync — RegBank is asking for a POC that must keep "EU-only" behavior for all live traffic unless theres a verified regional outage. They want: 1) a copyable routing snippet they can include in their security review, 2) exact list of APAC subprocessors wed call on failover, 3) how KMS/BYOK behave (can keys stay in EU?), and 4) rough cost bump for cross-region egress during a failover window. Need to feed security questionnaire by Monday. Can infra/security ops help?

tony_infra: cc @mike_sre @nina_security — yes this is supported. We usually implement "region_preferred" with an explicit failover gate that requires both regional health check failure and control-plane flag flip (so no accidental cross-region move). Caveats: cache coldness and batching will be impacted and some monitoring traces may appear in APAC for the failover duration.

tony_infra: Routing snippet for their doc (yaml, simple):
```yaml
routing:
  mode: region_preferred
  primary: eu-central-1
  failover:
    - ap-southeast-2
    - ap-northeast-1
  failover_policy:
    trigger: regional_health == DOWN && control_plane_ack == true
    max_reroute_ms: 250
    data_move_allowed: false
  audit_logging: true
```

mike_sre: Ops checklist items to include in the POC runbook:
- Validate healthcheck TTLs (we recommend 45s for this profile).
- Warm standby options: snapshot KV cache sync (optional) vs cold-start. If they want sub-100ms tail, we need pre-warmed APAC nodes.
- Bandwidth note: sample POC with 500GB/month baseline -> worst-case full failover additional ~400GB cross-region egress while backups sync.

mike_sre: Failover SLOs: if we accept cold-warm, expect median latency +60ms, p95 may spike during warmup. If they require consistent latency, recommend dedicated warm standby (adds ~30-60% infra cost).

nina_security: Subprocessors for APAC failover (we will provide full annex in questionnaire):
- ap-southeast-2: GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud DNS)
- ap-northeast-1: AWS (EC2, EBS)
- observability: Datadog (global), Sentry (optional)
We can mark Datadog ingestion retention to EU for non-failover, but during failover some telemetry will flow to APAC collectors.

nina_security: KMS/BYOK behavior: customers can BYOK and pin keys to EU KMS. During failover we use envelope encryption: ciphertext may be stored/served from APAC but unwrapping operations (Decrypt/UnwrapKey) are proxied to the EU KMS endpoint — we do not export plaintext key material to APAC. This adds cross-region latency (example: unwrap adds ~150-250ms). If customer forbids any cross-region KMS calls, we can restrict failover to read-only cached responses only (no unwrapping) or require manual approval for full failover.

leah_sales: Perfect. Can you also provide one short paragraph for the questionnaire that I can paste (routing + subprocessors + kms + logs + notification)?

nina_security: Paste-ready paragraph: "Redwood will apply a region_preferred routing policy for the RegBank POC. Normal production traffic is served from EU compute; APAC regions are configured as automated failover targets and will only accept traffic when EU is verified unhealthy and the failover control gate is activated. Subprocessors in APAC that may process traffic during failover are standard cloud providers (GCP and AWS) and monitoring vendors; a complete list is provided in the subprocessor annex. Customer-managed keys (BYOK) can be pinned to EU KMS; decryption/unwrapping is proxied back to EU KMS so key material is not exposed outside the EU. All failover events, routing decisions, and KMS operations are logged and retained per the agreed audit policy, and customers receive immediate notification on failover activation."

tony_infra: Pricing note for sales (ballpark): short blip failover (<2% of traffic): incremental egress ~$0.01-$0.03/GB depending on provider; negligible overall. Sustained failover (days): expect 25-45% uplift mostly from egress and extra compute due to cache inefficiency. We can produce a tailored PDF with their expected monthly traffic numbers.

leah_sales: Good. Please attach subprocessor annex + cost PDF by Fri COB and a short ops runbook section for the POC. Also include the exact YAML snippet for their security team.

mike_sre: I'll drop a short runbook + chaos commands into the shared drive and ping here when done. Quick chaos snippet for POC test:
```bash
# simulate eu-central network partition
kubectl label nodes -l region=eu-central network=isolated && sleep 90
redwoodctl tenant show-regions --tenant regbank
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2499-regbank-eu-prefailover-poc -> staging succeeded :white_check_mark: (tag: ppc-eu-prefail)

leah_sales: Thanks all 44d. I'll package the questionnaire answers and the YAML example and send to RegBank. If you add anything to the annex, please post here."
